sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the instant application has been filed in the changed circumstances on the basis of the deposition of PW-1/opposite party no.2 before the Trial Court.

Vide order dated 26.10.2018, this Court passed the following order:
"Heard applicants' counsel as well as learned AGA for the State and perused the record.
Submission of counsel for the applicant is that with regard to some alleged transactions a complaint under section 138 N.I. Act was filed by opposite party no.2.
Reliance in this regard has been placed on Annexure No.4 of the application.

Further submission is that when the opposite party no.2 did not succeed in getting any refund out the same the present false case has been lodged simply to harass and exert coercive pressure upon the applicant.
Submission is that in such circumstances there are seriously question marks on the validity and the maintainability of the present case.

Submission is that malafides behind the prosecution are apparent on the face of record and if the proceedings against the applicants are allowed to go on, it will result in the abuse of court's process.
Contentions
raised
at the bar
require detailed hearing on law and facts both.
Notice on behalf of opposite party No.1 has been accepted by learned AGA.
Issue notice to the opposite party no.2 returnable within four weeks.
Opposite party no.2 may file counter affidavit within three weeks after the service.
Learned AGA may also file counter affidavit within the same period.
Rejoinder affidavit may be filed within two weeks thereafter.
List this matter immediately after expiry of the aforesaid period before the appropriate bench.

Till the next date of listing further proceedings of case No. 5739 of 2016 arising out of case crime no.251 of 2016, u/s 420, 406, 506 I.P.C., P.S.- Sadar Bazar, District- Meerut pending in the court of C.J.M. Meerut, with regard to applicant namely Faragat Ali Rana, shall remain stayed. "
5.Subsequently, the opposite party no.2 appeared and filed counter affidavit alongwith an application for vacation of the stay.
Applicants were granted time to file rejoinder affidavit on 28.02.2020.
Till date no rejoinder affidavit has been filed by the applicant.
6. Learned counsel for the applicant relying upon an order passed by the Apex Court in case of State vs. K.V. Rajendran : 2008 (8) SCC 673.
Learned counsel for the applicants submits that if there are changed circumstances, second application u/S 482 Cr.P.C. is maintainable for quashing of the proceedings.

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for opposite party no.2 and the learned counsel for the State jointly submit that since the earlier application u/S 482 Cr.P.C., for the same relief was dismissed and prayer for quashing was already refused, the second application u/S 482 Cr. P.C. is not maintainable and the order of the Apex Court relied upon by the applicant was based over the peculiar facts of that case where the investigation was transferred from State Police to CBI.
8.

Learned counsel for opposite party no.2 further submits that since the interim order was not extended after 28.02.2022, the trial Court has already proceeded with the Trial and the Trial is proceedings and Non-bailable Warrant (NBW) has already been issued against the applicant herein.

Hence, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 and the learned counsel for the State pray for rejection of the instant application.
9.
Having heard the rival submissions made by learned counsels for the parties, this Court has carefully perused the record of the case.

Since, the earlier application u/S 482 No. 17485 of 2017 (Faragat Ali Rana vs. State of U.P. & Another) was already dismissed by this Court and a prayer for quashing proceedings and chargesheet was refused

sentences.text: , the instant application u/S 482 Cr.P.C. is not maintainable.
The change of circumstances, which is alleged by the counsel for the applicant is the deposition of opposite party no.2 during the trial.
If on such developments in the case are treated as change of circumstance, this will open up a Pandora Box.
Depositions made during the trial shall be considered at the time of the final judgment pending in the Trial.
In the order of the Apex Court in K.V. Rajendran (supra), the change of circumstances was with regard to transfer of investigation from State Police authorities to the CBI.
Therefore, the change of circumstances must be of such a nature, which goes to the root of the matter.
Any development in trial cannot be said to be the change of circumstances, entitling the accused to again approach for quashing of the criminal proceeding.
Therefore, this Court do not find any good reason to entertain the instant application and the same is dismissed.
Order Date :- 18.8.2023
